query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "unpublished_count!",
                COALESCE(
                    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(created_at))),
                    0
                )::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "oldest_age_seconds!"
            FROM outbox_events
            WHERE chain_id = ($1::text)::numeric
              AND published_at IS NULL
